name: Miyamori Haruka
source:
She is basically a flirtatious person, but she is calmer than Rio, and often keeps Rio in check when she gets out of control.

Because of her excessive preference for men, she has never had a boyfriend.

Although she doesn't usually show it, she actually likes cute things and secretly likes shotas.

[Translated from the [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk002/]official website[/url]]
